caption: The drawing shows a metallic mortar and pestle placed centrally on a light beige background. The mortar is cylindrical and flares out toward the top rim and base, which is thick and rounded. The pestle is slender and tapers smoothly from the wide handle to a narrower end that rests inside the mortar. The entire mortar and pestle are colored in various shades of brown and bronze, with the artist depicting highlights and reflections to suggest a metallic, polished surface. There are no additional objects, patterns, or background elements in the image; the composition focuses exclusively on the mortar and pestle.
title: Mortar and Pestle
